data.title: Hearing notice in guardianship proceedings for your mother
data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterwernigerode (Betreuungsgericht) invites Uwe Beispielharz, as son, to a hearing on 21 January 2027 at 13:30 as part of the guardianship (Betreuung) proceedings for his mother, Gertrud Beispielharz.
data.explanation: The court is deciding whether to appoint a legal guardian (Betreuer) for your mother and wants to hear your view as her son. The hearing takes place at the nursing home where she lives. Attending is welcomed but not required by law; if you cannot come, you may send your opinion in writing instead. There is no payment or formal deadline here — simply decide whether to attend or write, since the court will proceed with the decision either way.

items.title: Hearing as participant in the guardianship proceedings for your mother
items.action: Attend the hearing at the nursing home, or send your view in writing if you cannot attend.
